properties.description:
`stale_edge_evidence(node_id)` reads the `evidence` and `note` on every edge touching a node and names those still using language the node has DROPPED — comparing against the node's most recent snapshot, so a term that was never about the node is not confused with one the node has since lost. Surfaced by `propagate_change`, keyed by seed, because that is the call already putting those edges in front of a reader.

Reports `edges_with_prose` so an empty result over zero examined edges is distinguishable from one over twenty, and a `coverage_note` when there was no prior state — silent about the edges rather than clean on them. Warning only; it never refuses a write, and it carries its own caveat that it is lexical rather than semantic.
properties.name: An edge whose prose outlived the node it points at is named, with the terms that moved
